installCommand.linux: mkdir -p node_modules/.bin && curl -fsSL https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v2.102.0/gh_2.102.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz | tar -xz --strip-components=2 -C node_modules/.bin && chmod +x node_modules/.bin/gh
installCommand.win32: $version = '2.102.0'; $root = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'gh-cli-install'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $root, 'node_modules\.bin' | Out-Null; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v$version/gh_$($version)_windows_amd64.zip" -OutFile (Join-Path $root 'gh.zip'); Expand-Archive -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'gh.zip') -DestinationPath $root -Force; Copy-Item (Join-Path $root "gh_$($version)_windows_amd64\bin\gh.exe") 'node_modules\.bin\gh.exe' -Force; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $root -Recurse -Force
